map.按新车价、车龄与里程估算二手车参考价格。: Estimate a used-car reference price by new-car price, age and mileage.
map.成新率估价：车龄成新率 = 1 − 车龄 × 5%；里程成新率 = 1 − 里程: Condition-rate valuation: age condition rate = 1 − age × 5%; mileage condition rate = 1 − mileage (10k km) × 3%; the composite condition rate takes the smaller of the two and is limited to 45% to 100%; valuation = new-car price × composite condition rate, then floats up/down by condition to form a residual range.
map.买卖车前快速估算残值：输入新车价、上牌车龄、累计里程，得成新率与估值区间。: Quickly estimate residual before buying/selling: enter new-car price, registration age and accumulated mileage to get the condition rate and valuation range.
map.对比不同车龄/里程组合的估值，判断现车报价是否合理。: Compare valuations of different age / mileage combinations to judge whether the current car's quote is reasonable.
map.作为置换补贴或保险定损的粗略参考基线。: Serve as a rough reference baseline for trade-in subsidy or insurance loss assessment.
map.以「新车价 20 万、车龄 4 年、累计里程 8 万公里」为例: Example: new-car price 200k CNY, age 4 years, accumulated mileage 80k km
map.车龄折旧率=1-4×0.05=0.80；里程折旧率=1-8×0.03=0.76；: Age depreciation rate = 1-4×0.05 = 0.80; mileage depreciation rate = 1-8×0.03 = 0.76; take the smaller and limit to 0.45~1 → condition rate 0.76 (76%); valuation = 200000×0.76 = 152k CNY. If age is only 3 years and mileage 50k km, condition rate 0.85, valuation about 127.5k+ (150k new corresponds to 127.5k).
map.成新率为什么取车龄和里程的较小值？: Why take the smaller of age and mileage condition rates?
map.车辆残值受「车龄折旧」与「里程折旧」双重约束，任一维度恶化都会拉低价值，因此取两: Vehicle residual is constrained by both "age depreciation" and "mileage depreciation"; whichever dimension worsens pulls value down, so the smaller one is taken (with a 0.45 floor to prevent zeroing) as the composite condition rate. Mileage unit is 10k km.
map.估值和实际成交价差很多？: Does the valuation differ a lot from the actual deal price?
map.本工具是线性简化折旧模型，未计入品牌保值率、车况、地区行情、配置与事故历史。实际: This tool is a linear simplified depreciation model that does not count brand retention, condition, regional market, configuration or accident history. The actual deal should follow the market same-model deal price and professional inspection; this valuation is only a quick baseline reference.
